name: Electrical Components International
old_description: ECI’s roots are in Home Appliance and since 1953, we have built a legacy of leadership in space. We are the global leader of wire harnesses and control boxes to the largest Appliance OEMs worldwide.
about:
Founded in 1953 as Burcliff Industries in St. Louis, Missouri, the company was renamed Electrical Components International (ECI) in 1998. Now headquartered in Creve Coeur, Missouri, ECI has been owned by Cerberus Capital Management since 2018 and became part of Rosebank Industries in 2025.

ECI designs, engineers, and manufactures electrical distribution systems including wire harnesses, control box assemblies, and high‑voltage solutions with proprietary cable technology. The company operates 30 manufacturing facilities across nine countries with 17,000‑plus employees, managing thousands of unique SKUs for more than 400 OEM customers. Vertical integration allows custom‑engineered components to be produced in‑house, reducing lead times and simplifying supply chains.

The company serves diversified end markets such as data centers, commercial electric vehicles, advanced driver safety, aerospace and defense, medical devices, semiconductor equipment, industrial machinery, agriculture and construction, commercial lighting, and appliance and HVAC (including residential and commercial HVAC and specialty appliances). Recent customer examples include a leading data center operator, a global HVAC manufacturer scaling for a U.S. government contract, and a warehouse automation and robotics firm.

ECI states its mission is to create exceptional value by reliably managing complexity at scale, emphasizing global footprint with local execution, customer partnership from design through delivery, robust quality systems, on‑time delivery, supply chain resilience, and speed to market through rapid quoting and program management.
